metadata.description: Argus — the hundred-eyed watcher. Watches YouTube videos and Instagram reels for you and files runbooks into a searchable vault.

plugins.name: argus
plugins.description: Watch YouTube videos and Instagram reels — transcript, on-screen frames, and audio — and turn them into runbooks in a searchable Obsidian vault. Save in 2 taps on your phone, process with one command.
